notes.text: Cristian enjoyed the gardening group and talked about growing tomatoes as a child.
Cristian needed hands-on help getting out of the tub today and said he has been skipping showers because he is afraid of slipping.
Chronic conditions reviewed and stable. Continue current plan.

ADL reassessment. Cristian now needs moderate assistance with bathing and lower-body dressing; independent at last review. Recommend tub transfer bench, handheld shower, and increasing home care hours for bathing support.

Cristian reported a fall at home on Oct 3, 2026 in the bedroom getting out of bed. His niece Kevin found him on the floor. Denies head strike or loss of consciousness. No injury noted on assessment. Vitals stable. Fall risk reassessed as high. PT referral placed for gait evaluation.
Cristian enjoyed the gardening group and talked about growing tomatoes as a child.

PT evaluation following fall on Oct 3, 2026. Gait slow and unsteady with intermittent cane use; Timed Up and Go 19 seconds. Recommend front-wheeled walker, home safety evaluation, and grab bars in the bathroom. Will see twice weekly for strength and balance.
Picked up for day center on time; no issues during transport.

Kevin reports Cristian has been more confused in the evenings for about two weeks, once leaving the stove on. Oriented to person and place today but not date. No fever. Plan: urinalysis, medication review, and PCP visit this week.
Picked up for day center on time; no issues during transport.

Weight 102.3 kg, down from 110.8 kg on Sep 5, 2026 (8%). Cristian reports poor appetite and skipping breakfast. Eating about 50% of day center lunches. Plan: oral nutrition supplement twice daily, weekly weights, and dental check for chewing problems.
Picked up for day center on time; no issues during transport.
